onboarding.step1_body: Brick VPN is open-source, free of ads and trackers, and keeps your server profiles encrypted locally on your phone.
onboarding.step1_point1: Zero traffic logs; anonymous diagnostics off by default
onboarding.step1_point2: Android Keystore encryption for saved profiles
onboarding.step2_body: Brick VPN downloads its official free server directory automatically over HTTPS. Browse servers by country and city, and updates happen on their own — no account required.
onboarding.step2_point1: Free to start — no account required
onboarding.step3_body: The first time you tap Connect, Android will ask for permission to create a VPN connection. This lets Brick VPN route your traffic through an encrypted tunnel.
onboarding.step3_point1: Shown by Android once for your protection
onboarding.step3_point2: You can disconnect or revoke access anytime

settings.privacy_policy_subtitle: No ads, no trackers, diagnostics off by default
settings.privacy_policy_body: Brick VPN collects no personal data, browsing history, DNS queries, or analytics on any plan. The Free plan needs no account. Anonymous server health diagnostics are off by default; if you turn them on, only a hashed server identifier, reachability, latency, coarse network class, and an hour-bucketed timestamp leave your device. If an optional Brick Pro plan launches later, only a minimal account identifier and subscription entitlement status would be stored, and this policy would be updated before then. Server configurations stay encrypted on your device using Android Keystore.
